summary: Rules audit #921. (8) A Dishonorable death's Honor loss is now a rulebook change in GainHonor: card-effect Honor modifiers, action-scoped reductions/reactions (Chugo, Unimpeachable Name, Renyu, Solid Defense/Rhetoric window, Nexus of Lies, Den of Iniquity, Court Scribe/own-card filters) neither change nor are consumed by it; the stronghold Honor-loss immunity policy is unchanged. (9) Set/Copy/Exchange measure the necessary modifier from the raw Force/Personal Honor (no floor, no cap). (11) Tireless Efforts and Creating Order now hide the modifiers they negate (AppliedModifier.SuppressedTurn) instead of deleting them, so a surviving permanent modifier counts again next turn.
validation: Regressions in honor-modifiers, force-cap, forgotten-legacy-batch-3; full gate run before push (see PR).
remaining: Needs a ContentVersion bump (engine outcomes change for replays). Gift Armor/Aka-beko/Peace of the Kami purges and one-shot cleanses still delete (not duration-bound).
